name: devkit-skills
description: Curated agent skills for fullstack teams: Angular, React and Next.js frontends with Java / Spring Boot backends. Official framework skills are referenced from upstream; cross-cutting skills are maintained here.

plugins.name: angular
plugins.description: Official Angular skills (angular-developer, angular-new-app) fetched from github.com/angular/skills, the mirror of angular/angular. Signals, control flow, Signal Forms, SSR, testing, CLI tooling.

plugins.name: react
plugins.description: Vercel's React skills: vercel-react-best-practices (performance rules), vercel-composition-patterns, react-view-transitions, web-design-guidelines. Fetched from vercel-labs/agent-skills.

plugins.name: nextjs
plugins.description: Official Next.js skills from vercel/next.js: Cache Components and Partial Prefetching adoption and optimizers, bundle optimizer, dev-loop verification. Installs the react plugin as a dependency. Next.js 16.3+ also generates AGENTS.md pointing at its bundled docs.

plugins.name: spring-boot
plugins.description: Team conventions and testing guide for Spring Boot 4 on Java 21-25: project structure, REST with RFC 9457 Problem Details, JPA, configuration, Testcontainers, slice tests, ArchUnit.

plugins.name: spring-boot-community
plugins.description: Community Spring Boot 4 skills by Siva Prasad Reddy (sivalabs): spring-boot (deep references for JPA, MVC, Modulith, Testcontainers), java-code-review, jspecify, spring-modulith-verifier. Fetched from sivaprasadreddy/sivalabs-agent-skills.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Framework-agnostic TypeScript frontend skills: typescript-conventions (strict TS, lint and format, boundary validation) and frontend-testing (Vitest + Testing Library, Angular Vitest builder, MSW, Playwright).

plugins.name: fullstack
plugins.description: Cross-stack skills: api-contract (OpenAPI-first between Spring Boot and TypeScript clients), review-checklist (team code review), fullstack-feature (contract-first feature workflow).
